detail.text: Soft blue mushrooms lit the path like rows of tiny lanterns. The evening woods were not black at all. They were silver, and blue, and gently, gently shining.

detail.text: 'Good evening, little ones,' said Owl, from her mossy doorway. 'Ruby — you look surprised. Did no one ever tell you?'
